title: Tooltip
description: react-aria-components tooltip with the house surface. Re-exports TooltipTrigger and Focusable so consumers compose without importing react-aria directly.

anatomy.description: Re-exported from react-aria-components; wraps the trigger and the Tooltip. No provider needed.
The floating label; offset defaults to 6px, className extends the surface.
Re-exported wrapper for non-react-aria triggers such as a router link.

usage: Wrap plain DOM or router-link triggers in Focusable so they receive focus and hover events.
Tooltips carry supplementary text only; never put the sole accessible name of a control in a tooltip.
